test_title: PYST 47 - SSC CHSL 2025 - General Intelligence (Held On: 29 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
In the following figure series, select the figure which can be placed at the sign of question mark (?) from the given alternatives.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fb1eca0f2141837109038d44b68669a9835c023b356b2ede76eb4260361c09d1.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Observe two things changing:**

 
• Position of the small circle (dot)
 
• Orientation of the inner square line

Tracking the dot:

1st → bottom-left

2nd → top-left

3rd → top-right

4th → bottom-right

The dot is moving clockwise around the square

So next position → bottom-left

Tracking the inner line:

 
• It rotates along with the figure (same clockwise movement)

Thus, The next figure should have:

 
• Dot at bottom-left
 
• Inner square aligned accordingly

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/600f4bc5599581df5c2dab4b66be62246d1440ac04d2969a14eb7213d37d7b5f.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
